maddeler.e:
تعلوطوا (form XIII)
# تَعْلَوِّطُوا (taʕlawwiṭū) /taʕ.law.wi.tˤuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِعْلَوَّطَ (iʕlawwaṭa)
# تُعْلَوَّطُوا (tuʕlawwaṭū) /tuʕ.law.wa.tˤuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِعْلَوَّطَ (iʕlawwaṭa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
